title: Indian Outfit for a Baby Shower or Godh Bharai: Guest and Mom Looks
excerpt: What to wear to a baby shower or godh bharai: comfortable Indian outfits for the mom-to-be and graceful guest looks, with colours, fabrics and fit tips.
body:
For a baby shower or godh bharai, the best Indian outfit is soft, colourful and easy to sit in. Guests look lovely in pastel kurta sets or a light Anarkali, while the mom-to-be is most comfortable in a flowing Anarkali, a loose kurta set or a maxi dress in breathable fabric. Here is how to choose for both.

## What is a godh bharai?

Godh bharai, meaning "filling the lap", is a traditional Indian celebration for an expectant mother. Family and friends bless her with fruits, sweets, flowers and gifts, and there is often music, games and a long, happy meal. Abroad, many families blend it with a Western baby shower, so the dress code can range from a relaxed home gathering to a hall full of guests in festive wear. If you are unsure, ask the host whether it is casual or dressy.

## Outfit ideas for the mom-to-be

The mom-to-be will sit on the floor or a decorated chair, stand for photos and move around greeting guests, so comfort comes first. Everyone's body and comfort level is different, so choose what feels good to you and check with your own doctor about anything specific to your health.

- **Flowing Anarkali:** A fitted yoke with a wide flare is a classic choice. It photographs beautifully and gives plenty of room around the middle.
- **Loose straight kurta set:** A relaxed kurta with soft pants and a light dupatta is easy to wear all day.
- **Maxi dress:** A cotton maxi dress is a lovely option for a daytime or garden shower. The [Navy Floral Hand Block Print Cotton Maxi Dress](/products/navy-floral-hand-block-print-cotton-maxi-dress/) is light and airy.
- **Avoid:** Stiff fabrics, tight waistbands, heavy lehengas and anything with a lot of hooks.

Choose cotton, soft blends or light georgette over heavy silks, and pick bottoms with a comfortable drawstring or elastic.

## Outfit ideas for guests

Guests should look festive but not overshadow the mom-to-be. Soft, cheerful colours and moderate embellishment are just right.

| Event style | What to wear | Colours |
|---|---|---|
| Casual home godh bharai | Embroidered cotton kurta set | Baby pink, mint, peach, yellow |
| Daytime baby shower | Block printed kurta set or co-ord | Pastels, florals, white with colour |
| Evening or hall celebration | Light Anarkali with dupatta | Lavender, sage, rose, soft blue |
| Western-style shower | Tunic with trousers or a printed dress | Any cheerful shade |

For a home celebration, the [Baby Pink Embroidered Cotton Kurta Pant Set](/products/baby-pink-bird-embroidered-cotton-kurta-pant-set/) is sweet and fitting, with a bird motif that suits the occasion.

For something a little dressier, the [Peach Pink Embroidered Cotton Kurta Set](/products/peach-pink-embroidered-cotton-flex-kurta-pant-organza-dupatta-set/) has an organza dupatta that adds polish without feeling heavy.

## Colours that feel right

Baby showers are bright, happy events. Pastels, pinks, yellows, greens and soft blues are popular and photograph well against floral decorations. Some families prefer to avoid all-black or all-white outfits for auspicious occasions, so if you are a guest and unsure, choose a gentle colour.

Many hosts now set a theme colour for photos. If there is one, a kurta in a matching tone makes you part of the picture. The [Mint Green Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Pant Dupatta Set](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) fits a fresh green or garden theme nicely.

## Styling and practical tips

- **Shoes:** Floors, rangoli and cushions are common, so choose flats or juttis that slip off easily.
- **Dupatta:** Pin it on one shoulder so it does not slip while you serve food or hold gifts.
- **Jewellery:** Light earrings and bangles. Avoid sharp pieces if you will be hugging the mom-to-be.
- **Layers:** Indoor halls can be cool in winter. A shawl or a fitted cardigan keeps you comfortable.
- **For the mom-to-be:** Bring a light second outfit if the event is long, and keep a soft shawl nearby.

## Frequently asked questions

**What colour should I wear to a godh bharai as a guest?**
Soft, cheerful colours such as pink, peach, mint, yellow or lavender are a safe and pretty choice.

**What should the mom-to-be wear for a godh bharai?**
Most choose a flowing Anarkali, a loose kurta set or a cotton maxi dress in a light, breathable fabric.

**Can I wear a dress to an Indian baby shower?**
Yes, especially if it is a Western-style or blended shower. A printed or floral dress looks festive and relaxed.

**How early should I order a custom outfit?**
